reviews.text: Specialist professionals, 100% recommended

Excellent care, with great ethics from Dr. Oscar Gutiérrez, who provided all the necessary information. The emergency room doctor was very professional and empathetic. My sincere gratitude for their professionalism and compassion ❤️

I arrived at the clinic because of an emergency. I rescue dogs, and although many are later adopted, they are all family to me. Most come from the streets and often arrive with serious health problems.

In Naia's case, because of the urgency, I took her directly to this clinic. Once she was there, I started looking at comments, ratings, and reviews, and honestly, I was terrified because I found some not-so-good opinions. Also, because of this work, I've had bad experiences with other clinics and veterinarians, so I was quite worried.

That's why I also think it's important to share when the experience is good, and mine was completely positive.

Lili, at reception, was super kind and attentive. Dr. Fernanda and the other doctors who treated Naia were very kind to her and kept me informed with reports, messages, and videos throughout her hospitalization.

Naia successfully overcame parvovirus and giardia. On the day she was discharged, it was so clear that she felt comfortable and attached to the veterinarians; in fact, she even had trouble letting go of one of their arms. For me, seeing that after several days in the hospital spoke volumes about the care and affection she received.

Furthermore, something I am incredibly grateful for is that the care didn't end when she left the clinic. After her discharge, they continued to write to me to ask how she is doing and to follow up on her recovery. For me, those little gestures demonstrate that they truly care about the animals they treat.

I can only thank them for taking care of Naia, for treating her with such love, and above all, for saving her. Her treatment wasn't cheap, but Naia's life was worth every penny.
Excellent hospital, they saved my kitten. Excellent service from Dr. Estefani Romero.

Terrible emergency room service, especially on weekends and at night. They take forever to open, and there's never a doctor available to see you quickly. They invariably have an emergency as an excuse not to treat you. It's not a 24-hour service. You're better off going to the side of the Periférico highway, almost at Vaqueritos.
I arrived with an emergency and was attended to quickly, the service was friendly and the price affordable.
Excellent place! The doctor who saw us was super friendly, we were seen very quickly, and the service was very good. I highly recommend it.
Excellent place! My shihtzu arrived with one eye in very bad shape and they managed to restore it to 100% functionality. We are waiting for surgery to correct the natural growth of his eyelashes.

Terrible service!! We took our dog to the ophthalmology department, and a doctor named "Grecia" attended to him. From the moment we arrived, they examined him and performed a CT scan (which they never shared with us). They wanted to keep him hospitalized for 15 days for follow-up. When we refused, they seemed to take it badly that we didn't keep our pet hospitalized the way they wanted, and they practically gave us the medication reluctantly. I don't doubt that there are good doctors, but personally, this doctor's treatment left much to be desired. We finally went to another clinic, and the diagnosis was completely different. There was no need to try anything else, and they operated on him the same day. He's just recovering now. But here, they wanted to give him only eye drops and charge us more than 10,000 pesos just to leave him there. You're better off looking for another option!

The best!!! Truly the best veterinarian there is for eye issues, plus he's incredibly kind and has genuine love for animals. Thank you for saving Willy and supporting the other rescued animals. ❤️‍🩹🙏🏼
The doctors provided excellent care and were 100% professional, especially Dr. Manuel Guzmán, who treated our dogs and cats in ophthalmology and always helped them.

We took my furry friend in because of a small bump that appeared on his eye. He rubbed it and hurt himself because it grew very quickly in just a few weeks. When we arrived at the clinic, the ophthalmologist, Jessica, treated him very well. She explained the diagnosis in detail and told us it needed to be removed surgically. He received very kind and professional treatment, and they answered all our questions about his care. Everything went very well; his eye is doing great. The bump was successfully removed, and he's been receiving follow-up care for another preventative eye condition. Dr. Jessica has treated him very well and has been very professional. I definitely recommend this place.
Excellent service! My chihuahua has improved tremendously. I am very grateful to Dr. Guzmán for his professionalism.
It's a great hospital, I appreciate the care they've given us and of course, Luna.

They're unable to handle the volume of patients they have, the place is very small and the reception staff are touch less and lack empathy.
The only professional and kind person I  encountered there was the veterinarian who explained to us what was my dog problem

Luita, our dog, was just discharged. They are incredibly attentive and loving, and the price is quite fair. I highly recommend them. They saved our Luita, and we are so grateful. Thank you so much! 100000/10

Dr. Guzmán and Dr. Mariana from ophthalmology took excellent care of my English bulldog. He had entropion and ulcers in his eyes, and the treatments and surgery they performed on my Tobby have worked very well. 🐶✨ Thank you!! …

While I believe the ophthalmology treatment my dog ​​received was adequate, Dr. Jessica Ortiz's approach was completely unsympathetic. She doesn't know how to handle patients. My dog ​​was in a lot of pain and wouldn't let her examine her properly, and instead of looking for alternatives, Dr. Jessica just got angry and gave her a sedative. Luckily, we were able to take her to another hospital where both the treatment and care were excellent. My dog ​​loves her new doctor and has no problem being treated there, which demonstrates Dr. Jessica's poor patient management skills.

During my appointment, the VMZ service was excellent (10/10). I had to wait a bit because they were treating a poisoned dog, but it was totally worth it. They were very careful and attentive, even at reception. The prices are great for a specialist clinic; a fantastic option if you have an emergency with your pets.
Highly recommended in ophthalmology
Excellent service, the doctors are very professional and loving with the pets.

A highly recommended hospital. Dr. Óscar Gutiérrez is an excellent doctor who treated my dog ​​with the utmost professionalism and helped him recover. The overall care was very good. Many congratulations to all the medical and administrative staff for their outstanding work. I am incredibly grateful for everything.

Good afternoon!

Could someone tell me the cost of a first-time ophthalmology consultation? It's for a kitten.
Marco is always busy 😢

I went to get some special drops for my pet. The service was good and fast, and the product is expensive but effective. The downside is the parking; there aren't enough spaces, and it's very difficult to find one on the streets where they're located.
The orthopedist and the ophthalmologist are excellent doctors. I loved their care and professionalism. Definitely the best.
They took perfect care of my dogs, they were very professional, with adequate attention time.

I highly recommend them.
They saved my three dogs simultaneously on a Sunday from poisoning.
They revived them a year ago today.
Thanks to Dr. Brenda Rubio and the other two doctors who were there that day.
Excellent service

I like the service; they treat the animals well, the veterinarians are incredibly patient and empathetic with the owners.
The problem is with reception. They often don't honor appointments, or they don't even register you even if you made the appointment a day or a week in advance. Sometimes they don't answer messages or calls. I don't mind waiting if there's an emergency, but if there is, they should let you know beforehand so you know it will take a while.

I took my dog ​​to the emergency room on Saturday, July 25th, and they told me he had a tumor detected by ultrasound and that surgery was urgent because his life was at risk. They charged us 15,000 pesos and supposedly a donor was needed, but they operated anyway. He was in so much pain I couldn't process what was happening. It wasn't clear to me, and I have many questions. Unfortunately, he has already died, but I felt compelled to share my experience at that hospital because it was very suspicious that they wanted to operate so quickly even though there was no donor. Their intervention was unclear to me. I can't bring my dog ​​back, but if you find yourself in a similar situation, be careful because all they care about is getting paid immediately.
Very good service
Excellent care from Dr. Guzmán and his Ophthalmology team; the care for my little one has been the best at all times.
I took my dog ​​in for an eye ulcer; the ophthalmologist was careful and clear in her explanation.

Excellent service. They are very kind and patient, both with the animals and the families.

They are empathetic, without a doubt, and they make us feel better in emergencies.

My dog ​​is doing very well now; she recovered quickly, and I am very grateful. It's true that we arrived in an emergency and they attended to another dog first, but this was only because of the severity of our dog's condition.

If I had been the owner, I would have been even more grateful. I didn't find anything wrong with them.

I will definitely be returning more often.
We had an emergency at 2:00 am and Dr. Orlando gave us excellent service, in addition to an affordable cost.
Everything was excellent.

A terrible experience. It turns out this isn't the first time I've been to this place. They had already treated my dogs without a doctor's order. And this time, I made an appointment. However, when I arrived, nobody knew anything. I showed them the screenshot of the appointment confirmation, and it showed a veterinarian with red hair saying the test couldn't be done. The point is, they're wasting my time. And again, this isn't the first time I've gone to this place for tests without a prescription. It's incredibly unprofessional; they're not even organized among themselves. It's worth noting that the receptionist wanted me to schedule her appointment... because, obviously, they wanted to make more money. Anyway, they're already a disgrace here in Tepepan.

If you have an emergency, don't go to this hospital. I've taken my dog ​​there since she was a year old, so they have her entire medical history. She has a chronic condition. I took her to the emergency room because she was vomiting and passing blood, but they wouldn't admit her because there was only one doctor! And they said there was no point in waiting because he was very busy. I asked for her file, and they wouldn't give it to me because the doctor was the only one who had it. I mean, I take my dog ​​there for follow-up care, and when she needed treatment, they wouldn't admit her. When I told the receptionist that they should be able to handle emergencies, she said some doctors were on vacation. I'm never taking my dog ​​there again, although honestly, I don't think they care.
Very good service
They are truly the best!!!

Today I visited them for an emergency my kitten had. They were very busy, but they didn't have the decency to tell us they weren't going to see us. They left us waiting for 40 minutes in a room where people were going in and out, and no one said anything to us. After 45 minutes, since my cat was crying, I went to reception. They sent us a doctor who asked two questions, barely touched my cat, and said, "This isn't an emergency yet; we'll have to wait longer." I definitely left, went to another clinic, and they saw her immediately. Unfortunately, my kitten didn't make it, but if you have an emergency and don't have an appointment, don't go to this place.

Terrible service, unethical, and overcharged!!
My experience at this clinic was extremely disappointing. Not only do they completely lack empathy and humanity towards animals, but their professional ethics are questionable. I paid an exorbitant amount for tests they claimed to be performing on my pet, who arrived with a trauma, but they never showed me any results or evidence that they had actually done them.

Furthermore, when I formally requested the results of the tests they did, they sent me incomplete and incorrect information. It's frustrating to feel that they take advantage of our vulnerability and the health of our pets by charging for services they don't provide or can't verify. I do not recommend this place under any circumstances, especially when it comes to felines. They never did anything for my pet; they just kept him sedated, and they have zero experience with trauma cases.
The night shift with Dr. Brenda Ruiz was terrible, and the follow-up was even worse.

This is the second time I've had to go there for emergencies because I live nearby and they have good vets, but they're really rude. Even if you go in for an emergency, they won't see you at reception. My dog ​​came in with a bite on his neck, and they told me the doctor is very strict with her schedule and wouldn't be able to see him without an appointment.

The place is very clean and well-controlled for the dogs' safety. They treat the animals well and prioritize their well-being.
We came on the recommendation of the UNAM Veterinary Specialty Hospital.

Slow to triage in an emergency, the costs were considered excessive and outrageous for medications and medical supplies.
My pet sadly passed away and had to be euthanized due to a general failure. The veterinarian initially only mentioned possible poisoning, and after a seizure, she referred to a possible neurological abnormality and heart failure.
Good service, specialist doctors, ophthalmology, among others

We took my dog ​​Peluza to the vet, and from the very first moment, the treatment we received, both from us and from Peluza, was very kind and affectionate. They were very caring with my baby, and the service was excellent overall. Each of the doctors who treated Peluza is very good; I highly recommend them. Dr. Guzmán, Dr. Orlando, and Dr. Berenisse are all very professional.

The ophthalmology care is the best! Dr. Guzmán is a great specialist, and when he's unavailable, the other doctors are also very professional. They saved the eyes of my two Shih Tzus from a corneal ulcer, and I will be forever grateful. I highly recommend them!

I want to express my gratitude for the care and professionalism of both ophthalmologist José Manuel Guzmán Gudiño and his assistant, veterinarian Mariana López, who treated Wichus, my dachshund. We arrived with a corneal ulcer in her right eye caused by a kitten scratch, and a corneal scraping was necessary.

Although some complications arose during her recovery (due to my own mistakes), we received excellent follow-up, guidance, and treatment throughout. Both Dr. Manuel and Dr. Mariana always took the time to explain the situation, answer our questions, and acted with great dedication and empathy. They are specialists who inspire confidence and demonstrate a genuine interest in the well-being of their patients.

Today, thankfully, Wichus is much better. I highly recommend them to anyone seeking quality ophthalmological care for their pets. I was also impressed by their extensive experience with all types of animals; I'm a big fan! 👍
The ophthalmologist treated my pet excellently; I am very satisfied with the service.

The service provided by Dr. Guzmán Gudiño and the ophthalmology team is excellent; I consider it the best in the city. They have exclusive medications that are truly effective. They have helped many of my dogs here. The prices are fair, and the care is outstanding. I highly recommend this veterinary hospital.
The service from the moment I arrived was excellent. I took my dog ​​for vaccinations and an eye exam with Dr. Guzmán; he's an excellent veterinarian.
Excellent care and service, I highly recommend them. My dog's eyesight has improved a lot; their diagnosis and treatment were very accurate.

They were recommended to me, but the service leaves much to be desired. The prescription doesn't specify what your pet has, their follow-up is nonexistent, they don't answer questions, they are well-trained but the service is quite mediocre.

I don't recommend it. I took my dog ​​in for an emergency because she was vomiting a lot and had diarrhea. As soon as we walked in, they took a while to attend to her. When they finally saw us, they told us she would have to be admitted for $5,000. I didn't have that kind of money, and it seemed excessive considering they charged the same to another dog who came in with a more serious condition. I asked the doctor to help me with a prescription so I could stabilize her at home with medication, which she initially refused. Although she eventually gave me one, she knew my dog ​​was vomiting and couldn't keep any food down, yet she still prescribed pills. She showed no willingness to help; she wasn't interested in my dog's health, only in the money, demonstrating her lack of empathy.

I really don't know how people keep bringing their pets to this vet; they leave them crying and complaining all night without any attention, and their care leaves much to be desired; they're just in it for the money.

Excellent care, facilities, equipment, and spaces, all ideal for meeting the needs of patients. Very good follow-up, support, and detailed explanations. They performed surgery on my 12-year-old dog, and he recovered very quickly! Plus, the cost wasn't excessive.

We found this hospital online when our veterinarian told us that Nick, a Belgian Malinois, needed specialized eye care. That was two years ago. We called the number provided in the information, and from the very first appointment, we've received excellent care for both Nick and us. The receptionist is incredibly kind, and the ophthalmologist has been very professional and has greatly improved his eye condition.

The costs are high, but they reflect the quality of care the hospital provides. I highly recommend it. The place is very clean and organized, and they offer several specialties.

Overall, it's a good hospital with a highly trained medical team. The veterinarians' care is consistent, clear, and professional.

Although the facilities feel somewhat small for the volume of patients they receive, the quality of medical service isn't affected. However, a significant area for improvement is the reception area: there's a lack of communication between the receptionists, the medical staff, and clients, which leads to considerable appointment delays.

I want to especially highlight Dr. José Manuel, who is an ophthalmologist; thanks to his excellent diagnosis and follow-up, my dog ​​regained his sight. We continue to attend his checkups because of the trust and care he has provided us from the very first day.

We had to take our kitten to the emergency vet in the middle of the night. She received good care at a reasonable price, and they said she needed surgery, but in the meantime, she could stay at home until they contacted us to schedule it. The problem was that when we brought her home, she came off her bandage, and when we called to arrange a return visit to have it re-bandaged, they never answered. We called multiple times and sent messages via WhatsApp, but nothing. We had to take her somewhere else.
Excellent, they took care of my furry friend in the middle of the night! Thank you.
I took my dog ​​Lola to the ophthalmologist. He examined her thoroughly and prescribed a treatment that has helped her a lot. I highly recommend him.

I was recommended this hospital because my dog ​​lost her sight due to diabetes. Thanks to Dr. Guzmán, the ophthalmologist, and his highly professional care, my dog ​​can see again.
Therefore, I highly recommend this hospital to anyone I've seen suffer as I did.

Excellent service in the ophthalmology department! I am so grateful for the care and attention Dr. Guzmán has given my dog; his treatment was both humane and professional. I highly recommend him ❤️‍🩹 …
Excellent service.
I recommend the hospital because the care was quick and all the staff were very kind and empathetic.

I want to share my experience with the hospital where Carola had her eye surgery because it truly was a 5-star experience.

Before making our decision, we researched and compared different hospitals and doctors, and this was undoubtedly the best option.

From the first appointment and all the preliminary tests, the process was impeccable: organized, punctual, and always focused on taking care of every detail to maximize the chances of success, especially considering her diabetes. They made us feel at ease at all times.

The surgery was, honestly, a complete success. After the procedure, Carola stayed in the hospital for a few days under observation, where she received incredible care. They perfectly managed her diabetes and were very careful with her treatment, especially considering how sensitive her stomach can be with antibiotics.

When she was discharged, she returned home in excellent condition. But what really makes the difference is the follow-up: the medical team has been attentive, supportive, and available at all times.

It has been, without a doubt, an outstanding experience. Highly recommended.

Terrible service. I took my dog ​​in; she'd had a fever for four days. They only gave her an antibiotic injection and scheduled me for tests the next day. They told me they couldn't give her any medication without the results until they knew what was wrong, and that they would send them between 4 and 6 pm that same day.

I called during those hours, and they said they didn't have the results. My dog ​​is still sick with a fever, and it seems they don't care. They don't answer the phone, and the WhatsApp messages where you send proof of payment aren't going through either.

I had to call again on the third day, and they still hadn't sent anything. They said they didn't have the results yet. It's incredibly unprofessional, especially since they told me not to give her any medication until they knew the results.

We decided to take her somewhere else because it seems like they don't care whether the results are in or not, even though they themselves said they would have them the same day.

They answered in the afternoon, saying they only had one result and the other would be available in four days. If I had followed their instructions, something worse could have happened to my dog. They're punctual, but unclear. The receptionist is terrible; she says the doctor is out to lunch and she doesn't know when she'll be back.

They've left us tied up, because now we have to wait four days for the test results.

I don't recommend this place. They're unprofessional and the service is inadequate.

I came to this clinic because I was sent there in an emergency. My dog ​​had been running a high fever for four days, and the medication wasn't helping. But this clinic is anything but an emergency; they don't provide adequate care or service. They ran tests, but they didn't give me any medication or anything. They just told me I had to wait for the test results to see what medication to prescribe. Was I supposed to wait for her to get better on her own? They only seem to care when you're angry. The tests were useless because one of them took four business days to get the results, and I would have had to wait even longer. Thankfully, we moved to another clinic, and my dog ​​is better now.

If you love your pets as much as I do, my recommendation is: don't take them to this place. I had the bad luck, and the service was terrible.

I don't understand why their information says "open 24 hours" if, upon arrival, they say they can't see walk-ins. Then I asked about making an appointment, and they said they didn't have a doctor available at that moment. I asked if the doctor would be a while, and they said yes, IT WOULD TAKE A LONG TIME TO ARRIVE.

Even though they saw me arrive with my dog ​​in my arms, in very bad shape, how can they call this establishment open 24 hours?

Absolutely not recommended, zero empathy. In my opinion, save yourself the trouble of taking your pets to this place.

I found the service excellent, from the moment you arrive until you leave. There's a short wait, but it's understandable. The reception staff were incredibly attentive, and Dr. Sánchez is a very good veterinarian. He explains everything and is very kind to my furry friend. I highly recommend him.
Excellent service and good personal attention.

The receptionist was incredibly rude. I needed an ophthalmology appointment and they left me on hold for over 20 minutes. They don't answer, and as soon as they hang up and you try to call back, they hang up on you. Terrible service.

Excellent service!
I had an emergency last night and my dog ​​received the proper care.
The doctors were very kind.
Dr. Oscar is very professional.
Thank you, thank you, thank you!

They told us they would take an X-ray to check my dog, a 12-year-old Labrador, but because of his size, they couldn't use the machine and just switched to a simpler test without telling us, and it didn't provide any useful information. Anyway, they incorrectly diagnosed him with gastritis and prescribed a bunch of medications, which obviously didn't help at all. When our regular vet came to see him at home, without needing any tests, he knew it was kennel cough just from the symptoms. On top of that, the receptionist was incredibly rude and made a lot of faces at everything, and it's an expensive place.
Terrible service and exorbitant prices for an inconclusive diagnosis. If you can go somewhere else, avoid this place.
Excellent service

Excellent service. The reception staff was very kind and explained the entire procedure to me. They performed tests beforehand and explained each step. They kept me informed about everything that was happening with my little one, who was cared for with so much love.
They handed her back to me awake. Her doctor explained what happened in the operating room, and they gave me her medication, which had a cost (they had already told me that when they gave me the prices). Congratulations to everyone, especially Dr. Liz. Thank you for everything.
They are open 24 hours and I liked that they have everything necessary to give a good diagnosis 💓 …

Good morning! I was recommended this specialty veterinary center because my Chihuahua puppy has an eye problem. From the moment you arrive, they provide excellent service. We went to the ophthalmology department, where Dr. Jessica attended to us. She was truly outstanding, explaining my puppy's situation in detail. They are very caring towards their puppies, which I greatly appreciate, and I highly recommend this specialty veterinary center. Thank you!

We came to this hospital because, unfortunately, my dog ​​suffered an injury to his left eye that caused a corneal ulcer, and we feared he might lose his sight.

Fortunately, thanks to Dr. Guzmán and his team, he had a successful surgery, and he's progressing wonderfully, especially with the care of Dr. Jessica from the ophthalmology department, to whom we are very grateful. We followed the prescribed treatment, and my dog's vision improved so much that he was able to recover it.

A hospital of excellence. The first time, I took my dog ​​in for an eye problem that no other veterinarian had been able to solve. She eventually needed surgery, and we were in the best hands, those of specialist Óscar Gutiérrez. A true professional in every sense of the word. We are at home, deeply grateful to see our Milenka back to her old self. A huge thank you to the Veterinary Specialty Center.
Highly recommended
Excellent place 💗 The staff are super friendly and the doctors are very kind and empathetic with our cat. Dr. Sánchez always provides excellent care. 100% recommended 💜 …

My dog ​​had an ultrasound, and the results were given to us clearly and within the 72-hour delivery window they promised. When we arrived, they attended to us immediately, respecting our scheduled appointment time. The receptionist was very kind.

Ever since I discovered this specialty center, my canine family has been taking them there for checkups, and always with great results, excellent care, and kindness, especially with Dr. Jessica Ortiz, who treats my Boxer Daisy's eye. Daisy had a cataract, which she no longer has, thanks to Dr. Jessi. I love that she always greets Daisy with so much affection, and above all, her medical care is always fantastic. She answers all my questions, and obviously, as a doctor and as a person, she deserves a 10 out of 10!
100% recommended!
Highly recommended!

Ophthalmologist Manuel Guzmán is excellent; I have complete faith in him. He was able to diagnose my dog ​​after several treatments with general veterinarians. The only downside is that sometimes we do have to wait a while for our appointments. I wish they would be more efficient in that regard, but overall, I give the doctor a 10/10. I trust his knowledge and experience completely. :)

Excellent service. The staff is qualified, careful, and loving with all patients during consultations. The costs are fair, and in my dog's case, she has improved completely. Veterinarian Jesica is very dedicated and provides appropriate follow-up.
I am delighted with the care the hospital provides. I am so grateful to Dr. Guzmán Gudiño for restoring my little girl's sight. It gives me peace of mind to know a place like this exists.
They have a very professional team, from reception to Dr. Guzmán, who specializes in ophthalmology and has extensive knowledge and experience.
It is the best veterinary hospital in Mexico with the best staff, highly knowledgeable and empathetic professionals.

Excellent service from all the staff, from the receptionists to the cleaning staff, etc. Molly, cared for by Dr. Sánchez, has always been attentive to her. I appreciate his constant empathy towards my dog. I highly recommend him. I live all the way to Ticoman, and the distance doesn't matter; the treatment is excellent, and I don't go to any other hospital.

I took my dog ​​to the emergency room and they attended to him immediately and saved him! Dr. Bere Nidome is one of the best at the hospital, and the reception staff were excellent and always answered my questions. I highly recommend it! 👍 …

I took my dog ​​Cuco, who went blind, for a second opinion because at the clinic he was going to, a month and a half passed and my dog ​​was still blind. They did all sorts of tests on him, except for his eyes. The last test they did was an MRI, and it came back clear. Desperate, I asked the neurologist if he could treat my dog, and he recommended Dr. José Manuel Guzmán Gudiño. He indicated that all the previous medications should be discontinued, and Cuco started a new treatment. He's been on it for a week, and we're seeing results.

Excellent place, especially Dr. José Manuel Guzmán from the ophthalmology department. He's not only a great doctor, he's a wonderful human being. He's helped us so much with my cat Bombis, treating her with love and helping us find a solution for her. We are very grateful for all his help.

Excellent place to take your furry friend! I took my Zeus (a deer-head Chihuahua) for an ophthalmology appointment and Dr. Jessica treated him wonderfully, always very professional and clear in her at-home care instructions. Congratulations!

The best recommendations are for a highly specialized center with excellent service. The doctors are wonderful; they operated on my dog, and he's recovering well. I recommend them 100%; you won't regret it. They are very professional.

Excellent service, top-notch attention from the moment you request information, through reception, and with the doctors. They truly go out of their way to help you. My beautiful Akira was scheduled for eye surgery, but the doctor, with prior treatment, managed to avoid the operation. She is currently still undergoing treatment and improving. Thank you, Dr. Jessica, for such wonderful work.
Without a doubt, the best place to care for your pet.
Dr. Lizeth and ophthalmologist Jessica provide excellent service; they are very committed to their work and provide timely care!
Excellent service from Dr. Jessica; they guide you through the entire procedure.

The care and attention my dogs have received at this clinic is excellent. Whenever my dogs start having any vision problems, we come here without hesitation because we know the diagnosis is always reliable and accurate. I am so grateful to the doctors for being so ethical and highly trained. Lola, Elvis, and Kiara are very thankful to you.

I arrived at the Veterinary Center referred from another clinic for specialized ophthalmological care for my dog. From the beginning, Dr. Jess treated us with great care, and we received an immediate comprehensive diagnosis with a clear and effective treatment plan. Although managing the situation was complicated, Dr. Jess was with us every step of the way. We are very grateful for her professionalism and dedication.
Excellent service, Dr. Jessica was very punctual during my dog's eye exam; thanks to her, she regained her sight after surgery for a perforated cornea.

Excellent care from all the staff, and especially the doctors who treated my little girl...the ophthalmology department, Dr. Guzmán, Dr. Torres, and the entire team. Thank you so much for helping our beautiful children. I highly recommend them.
Vet José Manuel is very accurate in his diagnoses and his treatment of cats has always been excellent.
The veterinarians there are very good. Excellent care for my pet.

A terrible experience.

I took my cat for electrochemotherapy treatment for skin cancer on her nose, and the follow-up care was practically nonexistent.
From the beginning, they said it was urgent to treat her, but they gave me an appointment two weeks later because I requested it on a Friday. After the procedure, they only prescribed anti-inflammatories, without antibiotics, without a gastric protector, and without explaining detailed aftercare or possible complications.
At the follow-up appointment, they simply cleaned her nose and said that "it was normal that she wasn't eating." They never told us to switch to wet food or how to manage her lack of appetite.
When the situation worsened (sneezing, green nasal discharge, eye crust, lack of appetite, and weight loss) and we contacted the hospital, reception only responded with "the doctor isn't here" or told us to bring her back days later, even though it's supposed to be a 24/7 hospital.

The most concerning thing was that it seemed we were the ones who had to suggest the medications (antibiotic, gastric protector, appetite stimulant, vitamins), instead of receiving clear medical advice.

After paying 11,500 pesos, the least you expect is professionalism, follow-up, and empathy.
Unfortunately, here it seems they see pets more as an invoice number than as patients.

I want to congratulate you on having the best doctor in Mexico City with you.
